visual.description: Warm off-white cream used as the main page background throughout the site.
Deep navy-black that dominates the full-bleed hero video section, establishing the brand's dramatic dark tone.
Dark navy used in large editorial image blocks and campaign photography sections.
Same cream as page background, used for the navigation bar in its top-of-page state (with announcement banner above).
Near-black used for navigation menu labels in the top-of-page state.
Cream background persists on the sticky nav after scroll, now without the announcement banner.
Near-black used for navigation labels in the scrolled/opaque nav state.
Near-black used for body copy, footer links, and all standard text content.
Near-black used for product category labels and section headings.
Medium grey used for supporting text such as event subtitles and footer secondary labels.
Near-black used for the outlined SUBSCRIBE button border and other thin rule elements.
Near-black stroke on the SUBSCRIBE CTA button, which uses a transparent fill with dark text and border.
Warm golden-tan visible in the announcement banner strip at the very top of the initial page state.
